# WebIDE

> WebIDE is a free, open-source, privacy-first code editor and VS Code-style IDE that runs entirely in the web browser. Users open a local folder or any public GitHub repository and get the Monaco editor, file explorer, full-text search, VS Code extensions (themes, grammars, snippets), browser-local source control with diff and history, Markdown preview and a sandbox terminal. No install, no account; files stay in the user's browser (IndexedDB / File System Access API) and are never stored on a server.

Key facts:
- Price: free, no sign-up.
- Runs in: any modern browser; Chrome/Edge can read and write local folders directly, Safari/Firefox import folders via drag and drop.
- Open a GitHub repo: click "Open from GitHub" and paste `owner/repo` or a github.com URL.
- Limits: cannot run arbitrary programs or debuggers (no server-side execution); extensions needing Node.js do not work.
- Mobile: touch-friendly code-browsing layout on phones.
